item.title: 2023 NYC Heat-Related Mortality Report
item.description: Summary This report was corrected on Apr. 2, 2025, after we identified an error. The number of heat-exacerbated deaths was corrected from 345 to 555 and corresponding Figures 3 and 4 in the report were updated. We apologize for this error. More details on the correction. Each summer, on average, an estimated 560 New Yorkers die prematurely because of hot weather in New York City (NYC). These heat-related deaths account for about 3% of all deaths over the warm season months of May through September.
